text:
I built a Grok Bot that manages my Tailscale tailnet without getting my keys.

It joins as a tagged server (tag:grokbot), ACLs limit it to machines I pick, and it asks before any change. Audits, devices, Tailscale SSH.

Free template: https://x.ai/bot/xoIfh7oH4feicifYOgRMg

Not affiliated with Tailscale.

What would you let it touch?
